menus.title: 밀푀유나베 레시피 | 겨울 캠핑 육수와 소스

menus.main: Korean mille-feuille nabe: a low round stainless hotpot with tight concentric upright layers of napa cabbage, perilla leaves and very thin fully cooked beef in clear broth; brown shiitake and king oyster mushrooms at center.
menus.prep: Separated napa cabbage leaves, thin raw shabu-shabu beef in a separate shallow cream tray, fresh perilla leaves, king oyster and shiitake mushrooms, a small jug of clear broth.
menus.step: Close side view of a shallow stainless pot with uncooked upright layers of napa cabbage, perilla leaves and thin beef being arranged in concentric rings, mushrooms in the center, a small jug of broth next to it. No heat or active flame.

menus.title: 만두전골 레시피 | 냉동만두로 겨울 캠핑 한 끼

menus.main: Korean dumpling hotpot in a round stainless pot, six plump crimped half-moon dumplings fully cooked in a warm lightly red broth with napa cabbage, shiitake mushrooms, tofu cubes and scallions.
menus.prep: Six frozen crimped half-moon meat dumplings on a cream platter, napa cabbage leaves, shiitake and king oyster mushrooms, tofu block and sliced scallions separately arranged.
menus.step: An uncovered stainless pot seen from 45-degree overhead, broth with softened napa cabbage and mushrooms, crimped dumplings gently spaced on top and a clean ladle resting on an ivory plate. Fully open outdoor table, no burner.

menus.title: 닭한마리 레시피 | 캠핑에서 맑은 국물 끓이기
menus.label: 따뜻한 닭한마리
menus.main: Korean dakhanmari clear chicken hotpot with fully cooked pale bone-in chopped chicken pieces, thick potato slices and scallion segments in clean clear broth in a round stainless pot. No red chili in the broth.
menus.prep: Raw chopped bone-in chicken pieces in a separate cream tray away from vegetables, potatoes, scallions, onion, a tiny dish of minced garlic and a jug of water. Clearly separate raw chicken and clean vegetables.
menus.step: Stainless pot of clear chicken broth with fully cooked chicken pieces and softened potato slices; a clean ladle holding one chicken piece above the broth, a clean separate small dipping dish next to the pot. No raw meat near serving dishes.

menus.title: 순두부찌개 끓이는 법 | 돼지고기 양념과 재료
menus.label: 칼칼한 순두부찌개
menus.main: Korean red soft-tofu stew in a small stainless saucepan, generous irregular white soft-tofu curds, small fully cooked pork pieces, kimchi, onion and scallion. No raw egg or runny yolk.
menus.prep: Soft tofu in a cream bowl, small raw pork slices isolated on a separate tray, chopped kimchi in a small bowl, onion, scallion and a small dish of red chili powder.
menus.step: Close view of a small stainless pot where broad spoonfuls of white soft tofu have just been added to red cooked-pork and kimchi broth, clean spoon at the side. No egg.

menus.title: 고추장찌개 레시피 | 감자·돼지고기 한 냄비
menus.label: 든든한 고추장찌개
menus.main: Korean gochujang stew in a stainless pot with chunky yellow potato, cooked small pork pieces, zucchini half-moons, onion and scallion in a moderately thick red broth.
menus.prep: Potatoes, sliced zucchini, onion, scallion, raw pork on a safely separate small tray, and small dishes of gochujang and minced garlic on ivory ceramics.
menus.step: Close view of a stainless stew pot with red broth and half-submerged potato pieces, zucchini and cooked pork, a clean ladle gently turning one soft potato piece without mashing it.

menus.title: 소고기뭇국 끓이는 법 | 겨울 캠핑 아침 국물
menus.label: 맑은 소고기뭇국
menus.main: Korean clear beef and radish soup, a wide cream bowl filled with clear golden broth, thin translucent Korean radish slices, fully cooked small beef pieces and a few scallion rings, small stainless soup pot beside it.
menus.prep: Korean radish cut into thin broad rectangles, raw diced beef isolated in a cream tray, scallions, tiny dishes of minced garlic and soy sauce and a small water jug.
menus.step: Uncovered small stainless pot with clear broth, cooked beef and radish; a spoon lifts one translucent radish rectangle with clean white chopsticks resting separately on linen.

menus.title: 떡만둣국 끓이는 법 | 멸치육수 캠핑 아침
menus.label: 아침엔 떡만둣국
menus.main: Korean tteok-manduguk in two ivory bowls, clear anchovy broth with white oval rice-cake slices, fully cooked crimped dumplings, cooked yellow egg ribbons, scallions and a small amount of roasted seaweed flakes.
menus.prep: White oval sliced rice cakes, crimped frozen dumplings, two whole unbroken eggs, scallions and a small dish of dark roasted seaweed flakes in separate ivory dishes.
menus.step: A stainless soup pot showing cooked dumplings, oval rice cakes and fully set yellow egg ribbons in clear broth, a clean ladle pouring a portion into one ivory bowl. No raw egg visible.

menus.title: 김치우동 레시피 | 어묵 넣는 캠핑 국물요리
menus.label: 후루룩 김치우동
menus.main: Korean kimchi udon in a stainless pot, thick white udon noodles curled through a lightly red broth with chopped kimchi, rectangular fishcake pieces and sliced scallions.
menus.prep: A nest of thick white udon noodles on an ivory plate, chopped kimchi in a small bowl, rectangular fishcake sheets, scallions and onion, all unpackaged.
menus.step: Close-up of a stainless pot with kimchi and fishcake broth, thick udon noodles loosened and separated using clean chopsticks, no hands, no burner.

menus.title: 수육 삶는 법 | 겨울 캠핑 돼지고기·된장 준비
menus.label: 함께 나누는 수육
menus.main: Korean bossam suyuk: neatly cut slices of fully cooked boiled pork belly with alternating pale meat and white fat layers on an ivory platter, a separate small bowl of kimchi, onion and scallions; stainless covered pot in background.
menus.prep: One thick raw pork-belly block isolated in a cream tray, onion halves, scallions, garlic and a small dish of brown doenjang. No thin raw pork slices; it must be a whole thick block.
menus.step: A fully cooked boiled pork-belly block on a clean wooden board with several even slices cut from its end, a clean knife placed safely to the side, a small stainless pot and separate kimchi dish behind. No pink raw pork.

menus.title: 굴국 끓이는 법 | 겨울 굴 손질과 익히는 순서
menus.label: 겨울 한 그릇 굴국
menus.main: Korean oyster and radish soup in a cream bowl, fully cooked plump opaque ivory oysters with gently ruffled edges, translucent radish slices and scallions in clear broth, small stainless soup pot beside the bowl.
menus.prep: Raw shucked oyster meat in a separate chilled ivory bowl, thin Korean radish slices, scallions, small dish of minced garlic and clear broth jug. No shells and no raw oysters served with garnishes.
menus.step: Small stainless pot with clear radish broth and fully cooked opaque shucked oysters, one clean ladle lifting an oyster and radish slice, gentle steam, no raw oyster plating.

menus.title: 동태탕 끓이는 법 | 냉동 동태 손질과 양념
menus.label: 얼큰한 동태탕
menus.main: Korean spicy pollock stew dongtae-tang, thick skin-on cross-cut pollock steaks fully cooked in red broth with radish rectangles, tofu cubes and scallions in a round stainless pot. No salmon, cod fillets or crab.
menus.prep: Raw cross-cut frozen pollock steaks isolated on an ivory tray, Korean radish slices, tofu cubes, scallions and small dishes of red chili powder and brown doenjang.
menus.step: Stainless red soup pot with fully cooked skin-on cross-cut pollock steaks, radish and tofu, a clean ladle at the edge; fish steaks remain intact rather than shredded.

menus.title: 감바스 만들기 | 캠핑 새우·마늘·올리브유 준비
menus.label: 마늘 향 가득 감바스
menus.main: Spanish-style garlic shrimp gambas for Korean camping, small round black cast-iron skillet containing fully cooked opaque pink peeled shrimp, thick golden garlic slices and king oyster mushroom pieces in glossy olive oil; two small toasted bread triangles on an ivory plate.
menus.prep: Raw peeled shrimp safely isolated in a small ivory dish, peeled whole garlic cloves, king oyster mushroom slices, olive oil in a plain small glass jug and two white-bread slices.
menus.step: Close view of a black skillet with pale golden garlic slices and fully cooked opaque pink shrimp in gently shimmering olive oil; oil does not splash, smoke or burn, no active flame or hands.

menus.title: 우삼겹 숙주볶음 레시피 | 굴소스 없이 볶는 법
menus.label: 아삭한 우삼겹 숙주볶음
menus.main: Korean thin-sliced beef-belly and mung-bean-sprout stir-fry in a shallow black skillet, fully cooked curled beef, white sprouts with tiny yellow tips, onion and scallion, light soy glaze with no puddle of liquid.
menus.prep: Thin rolled raw beef-belly slices isolated on a small tray, a mound of clean mung bean sprouts with yellow tips, onion slices, scallion, a small dish of minced garlic and soy sauce.
menus.step: A black skillet with cooked thin beef-belly pieces at one side and mung-bean sprouts and onions freshly mixed on the other side; clean wooden spatula rests across the rim, no raw beef and no hands.

menus.title: 계란찜 만들기 | 캠핑 냄비 물 비율과 불 조절
menus.label: 몽글몽글 계란찜
menus.main: Korean fully cooked steamed eggs in a small stainless saucepan, soft set pale-yellow curds with tiny cooked carrot cubes and green scallion flecks, moist but no raw liquid egg, ivory spoon on linen at side.
menus.prep: Three whole brown eggs and one separate bowl of beaten yellow egg, a small glass measuring cup of clear water, finely diced carrot, scallion and a tiny salt dish. No textual markings on measuring cup.
menus.step: Close view into a small stainless saucepan of softly set fully cooked yellow egg curds with tiny carrot and scallion pieces; a spoon shows the moist set interior, no liquid raw egg and no foam overflowing.

menus.title: 고구마치즈구이 만들기 | 프라이팬 겨울 간식
menus.label: 달콤한 고구마치즈구이
menus.main: Two cooked Korean sweet potatoes cut lengthwise in halves on an ivory platter, fluffy golden-yellow flesh topped with melted golden cheddar cheese, a small butter dish and plain camping mug nearby. No exaggerated cheese pull.
menus.prep: Two small whole Korean sweet potatoes, two square golden cheddar slices on a separate plate, a small butter pat and a plain stainless lidded skillet on the oak camping table.
menus.step: A black shallow skillet holding two split fully cooked sweet potatoes with golden cheddar squares softening over their yellow flesh, a lid rests to the side and a little steam rises; no campfire, no foil directly on flames.
